title: Dr. Fazal Said (AWKUM) Attends International Training in Shanghai and Signs MoU with Chenshan Botanical Garden
text:
Dr.
Fazal Said, Associate Professor, Department of Agriculture,
Abdul Wali Khan
University Mardan (AWKUM)
, is participating in the
International
Training Program on Botanical Garden Management and Development
, being held
in Shanghai from
September 1–20, 2025
.

This
prestigious program brings together experts and academicians from across the
globe to exchange knowledge and best practices in the field of botanical
gardens, sustainable development, and conservation.

During
the visit, an important milestone was achieved as an
MoU was signed between
Chenshan Botanical Garden, Shanghai, and the Department of Agriculture, AWKUM
.
This agreement aims to strengthen academic and research collaboration, promote
joint initiatives, and enhance mutual learning opportunities in the areas of
agriculture and botanical sciences.

This
participation and collaboration mark another step forward in AWKUM’s commitment
to international engagement, research excellence, and capacity building.
